text_block_list.text:
Seeing Katsuragi Ace looking exhausted, I 
decided to take her to the infirmary to 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"You really don't have to be so 
considerate, you know."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Well, rest is crucial on the road to the 
summit! Let's get plenty of rest and start 
climbing again from there!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here we go! The Ace Grand Prix is 
underway! Among all the Umamusume gathered 
here, who will be crowned the Ace?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH! The Ace Grand Prix! Who on earth 
is gonna take it this year!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: The Ace Grand Prix...? What's that about?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Now then, on your marks, get set... START!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mom! Watch me! Today's ace is gonna be me! 
*nom nom nom nom*!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up my spot as the ace that 
easily♪ Hey! Hey! Breakdown!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'll become the ace of speed reading! 
Finished page one...! Finished page 
two...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the prize! The festival ace! A 
song brings a shower of applause in bloom! 
Thiiis is the Umamusume waaay~~♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
W-What kind of battle even is this?! What 
kind of ace are you all even trying to 
be?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Katsuragi Ace is slow out of the 
gate!? She can't be an ace like this!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
D-Damn it! This is the ace I strive to be! 
Just watch how I runnn~!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace! What an incredible 
comeback! With a magnificent run, she 
scores a maximum of 710 points to become 
the Ace!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: M-Me...!? Y-Yaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hah... Just a dream, huh.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was a great dream... Alright! 
All that's left is to make it real with my 
own two legs!

Ace secured a magnificent victory in his 
dream, completely recovering from his 
slump.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's a dead heat for everyone except 
Katsuragi Ace!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Because Katsuragi Ace ran off, it was 
deemed a forfeit.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What's that supposed to mean?! I didn't 
run away, I ran and fought!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "...Ah! What, just a dream?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You're saying my running doesn't resonate 
with you...? Even if it's just a dream, 
this feels awful...

Despite resting, Katsuragi Ace didn't seem 
to have shaken off her fatigue due to bad 
dreams.
